en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard of Romania's Black Sea coast showing sailing boats on Lake Siut‑Ghiol, a beach and shoreline, the Constanța seafront with a leaning pine, crowded beaches at Eforie and Mamaia, and a central view labeled Vasile Roaită. Title at bottom reads "Marea Neagră." The back says "REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMINĂ" and "CARTE POȘTALĂ," with a price and code.
